cur-fossil-flaming-cliffs.dateNote: On 13 July 1923 George Olsen of Roy Chapman Andrews' expedition found the first dinosaur eggs known to science here in the Gobi; the team had first reached the cliffs in 1922. Velociraptor and Protoceratops came from here too. The red sandstone is about 75–71 million years old (Late Cretaceous).

cur-fossil-nemegt.dateNote: Soviet expeditions led by Ivan Efremov found this basin in the Gobi in 1946 and dug out about 10 skeletons, among them Tarbosaurus. The rock is about 70 million years old (Late Cretaceous). Wikidata pins the formation at a rounded point in the basin.
cur-fossil-nemegt.summary: A great Late Cretaceous dinosaur graveyard in Mongolia's Gobi Desert.

q105087403.dateNote: Uncertain place: the Fighting Dinosaurs were found in 1971 at Tögrögiin Shiree; the pin is on Wikidata's point for the Djadochta Formation at the Flaming Cliffs, some way east.
